findings: Exhaustion as a cost requires a ready friendly unit and is paid before responses.
The Waters’ Wage uses three ready Gold only when played from facedown during its controller’s own turn.
Party Favors is chosen by the opponent during resolution; each participant receives their own draw or exhausted channel.

Invert Timelines completes the discard instruction for both players in turn order, then the draw instruction for both players in turn order (CR303.2.a/359.3.e/423/414); repeated empty Burn Out can end the game immediately (CR432.3). This ordering is a core-rule interpretation; no card-specific FAQ was found.
